phases.title: Foundation
phases.goal: What exists is recorded, the repo has a real test harness and CI, and known security gaps are closed.
phases.exitCriteria: On a clean clone, `npm ci && npm run check && npm test && npm run build` pass, the same runs green in CI, and a user cannot read another user's order or payment.

features.name: Baseline: record current services, routes, events and known gaps as the starting point
Test harness: Vitest across packages, wired into `npm test` and `npm run check`, first unit tests
Ownership checks on `GET /orders/:id` and `GET /payments/:orderId` (users see only their own data)
CI: GitHub Actions running check, test and build on every push and pull request
Spec dashboard: local Next.js app showing roadmap, feature progress and memory, live

phases.title: Checkout & Assistant
phases.goal: Checkout completes end to end through the saga, and the AI assistant reaches its planned feature set.
phases.exitCriteria: An order placed in the UI reaches `CONFIRMED` (or `CANCELLED` with a reason) without manual steps, and the assistant eval suite passes its agreed target on the configured model.

features.name: Saga payloads: align `inventory.reserved` with the payment consumer so checkout reaches `CONFIRMED`
Assistant: store policies in the prompt and human handoff via Kafka (design doc Phase 3)
Assistant: eval suite, answer feedback and usage analytics (design doc Phase 4)

backlog: Protect product write routes (admin role check at the gateway or in product-service).
Shared rate limiting (the gateway limiter is per process, in memory).
Assistant: `assistant.interaction` analytics events; compaction for long conversations.
Update the HLD/LLD `.docx` guide with the assistant service, then regenerate `doc_extract.txt`.
Server-side price lookup when adding to cart (the cart currently trusts the client's price).
